comment: DRAFT E2.1, 2026-11-22; thresholds require the lead's approval. Calibrated on complete shared-stream original days, seeds 73106 and 73107, both using engine e511168ff045 and OPENGOTHIC_ACTIVITY_EVENTS=0; the cancelled prefix was not used. See reports/engine/2026-11-14-npc-data/e2-tolerance.md. The single profile covers the five measured point forms, both pooled and individually. min_point_same_fp=0.94: worst measured 4643/4878=0.951824518245 (campfire); 234 of 235 mismatches are two seated NPCs exchanging free points, not loss of the activity. Headroom 0.011824518245 share (1.1824518245 percentage points); no nearest-WP threshold is fitted to the guarding route noise. Pose acceptance symmetrically excludes samples with legal waiting in either run from both populations: minimum measured 4870/4872=0.999589490969 (campfire), maximum 9125/9123=1.000219226132 (guarding); unchanged bounds 0.99..1.01 leave 0.009589490969/0.009780773868 ratio headroom. When TA changes its target waypoint, an initial uninterrupted hold of the previous post is excluded from arrivals independently in A and B. Guarding has 177 arrivals, p95 0 and maximum 5 game minutes; the previously reported maximum 0 was incorrect. Arrival p95 measured 0, limit 5 game minutes (one journal step); maximum measured 5, limit 10 (one extra step). Missing segments, stuck NPCs and double occupancy measured 0 and allow 0: a whole lost segment must fail independently of the share/ratio population. Completeness requires both days done and full length, zero unmatched samples and zero missing final NPCs. Held-point agreement is not applicable for STAND_WP; missing point columns fail point checks. On-point and pose status are physical measurements independent of a transient empty ZS between End and Init; state agreement is reported separately.
